source_name: Gzk.rks-gov.net — Gazeta Zyrtare (legal basis defining registers and chambers)
why_relevant: Law No. 04/L-093 on banks, MFIs and NBFIs defines which entity types must be licensed and registered by BQK; Law No. 2004/7 defines the Chamber; Law No. 04/L-042 defines contracting authorities. These texts tell you what the registers must contain and therefore what is collectable by right.

source_name: Contracting-authority self-publication of OSHP decisions (e.g. Ministry of Health document store)
why_relevant: Demonstrates a recoverable pattern: individual contracting authorities re-host OSHP decision PDFs (case-numbered, e.g. 'OSHP: 2023/0898') in their own document stores. When the OSHP site is incomplete or a decision is withdrawn, these mirrors preserve the appeal record.

source_name: Projektligji / Ligji për shërbimet e pagesave (Law No. 08/L-328 and the 2026 draft) — Office of the Prime Minister
why_relevant: The payment services law is what creates the PI/EMI/AISP categories and the BQK public register; draft amendments circulated by the government signal the next wave of licensing and of open-banking/instant-payment obligations that drive vendor selection.

source_name: MAPL Doracaku për Menaxhimin e Kontratave Publike (public contract management manual)
why_relevant: The Ministry of Local Government Administration's contract-management handbook documents how contracts are administered after award — amendments, extensions, terminations and record retention obligations at contracting authorities. For an archival cell this is the map of what post-award paperwork should exist and where it is supposed to be kept, which is the basis for targeted access-to-information requests when a contract's execution history is not published.

source_name: e-Prokurimi secondary legislation — Rules and Operational Guideline for Public Procurement (sq / sr / en)
why_relevant: Authoritative trilingual glossary generator: the same rulebook exists in Albanian, Serbian and English, so notice-type names, form codes and field labels can be aligned across languages (e.g. 'Njoftim për dhënie të kontratës' = 'Obaveštenje o dodeli ugovora' = 'Contract award notice'). Also defines publication obligations and thresholds that determine what will and will not appear on the platform.

source_name: KRPP annual reports on public procurement activities (Raporti Vjetor)
why_relevant: Statutory annual statistical report on all public contracts signed 1 Jan – 31 Dec, by authority, procedure type and value. Provides the denominator and market-structure context for banking/payments lots, and flags year-on-year shifts in centralised vs decentralised buying.

entity_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo
source_name: BQK procurement rulebook (Rregulla/Pravila për prokurim në BQK)
why_relevant: BQK appears to operate under its OWN Executive-Board-adopted procurement rules (amended Oct 2024) rather than purely the general Public Procurement Law. This determines whether BQK payment-system tenders ever appear on e-Prokurimi/OSHP at all — a critical scoping fact for any tender-tracking pipeline.

entity_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo
source_name: BQK — Rregullore për autorizimin, dhënien e miratimeve dhe qeverisjen e IP-ve dhe IPE-ve / registration of AISPs (B15)
why_relevant: Defines the licensing gate that creates new payment-institution buyers and imposes obligations (outsourcing approval, security, agent registration) that translate directly into technology procurement. Regulation vintages signal upcoming compliance-driven spend waves.

entity_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo
source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave
why_relevant: Non-bank PSP access to the Interbank Payment System is the trigger for non-bank players to buy connectivity, settlement and instant-payment integration technology; the regulation dates the opening of that market segment.

entity_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo
source_name: BQK — Rregullore për agjentët e ofruesve të shërbimit të pagesave dhe parasë elektronike
why_relevant: Agent networks are the physical distribution channel of Kosovo remittance and e-money firms; the agent regime governs registration of agent points and therefore the scale of agent-facing terminal, till and KYC tooling procurement.

entity_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo
source_name: BQK annual financial statements + external audit opinion
why_relevant: BQK's audited financial statements expose capitalised IT/payment-infrastructure assets, intangible software, operating expenditure lines and commitments — an indirect but reliable read on the size and timing of payment-system investment, usable when the tender itself is not published.

source_name: D+ (Demokracia Plus) — analysis of the organisation and functioning of the Regulatory Commission for Public Procurement (Serbian edition)
why_relevant: One of the few substantive Serbian-language documents located for this cell. D+ analyses how the RKJN (Regulatorna komisija za javne nabavke, the Serbian-language name for KRPP) is constituted and operates, including member qualification requirements and its control and supervisory functions. This matters archivally because it documents institutional composition at a fixed date, and because it establishes the Serbian terminology set — RKJN, javne nabavke, ugovori, okvirni sporazum — needed to search Serbian-language mirrors and northern-municipality publications.

source_name: IPA project fiches archive (DG ENEST document download service)
why_relevant: Historic and current Kosovo IPA project fiches (e.g. public finance) give the full intervention logic, indicative contract split (service/supply/twinning) and budgets — directly predictive of tender structure.

source_name: Asseco SEE Kosovo (ASSECO SEE SH.P.K.) — STIKK member profile
why_relevant: Confirms a local Kosovo legal entity for the region's biggest banking-software vendor, giving a local company name to hunt in procurement registers, court/business registry filings and local press. Member profiles typically carry the local site, contacts and self-described client sectors.

source_name: EBRD Kosovo news / project summary releases (financial-sector deals)
why_relevant: EBRD financial-intermediary deals in Kosovo (e.g. Go Digital in the Western Balkans credit line to Banka për Biznes, EU-blended incentives) are private-sector operations that generate no public tender, but the news/project-summary stream reveals where automation and digitalisation money is flowing and which banks are counterparties.

source_name: Swinto — fintech payments platform launched in Kosovo and Switzerland
why_relevant: Prishtina-founded transfer/payments platform in the diaspora corridor; a contract party for card, wallet and compliance vendors. Telegrafi/Express launch pieces are the main dated public record of such firms.

source_name: Kosovo public procurement law, Serbian-language text (Kuvendi archive)
why_relevant: Serbian-language statutory text establishing publication duties, thresholds and notice types. Foundational for knowing WHICH documents must exist for a given contract value and therefore what to look for and when a source is incomplete. Also a controlled vocabulary source. (Older law version - the current consolidated law should be sourced from e-prokurimi legislation section.)

source_name: SIGMA/OECD assessments of Kosovo public procurement & external audit
why_relevant: SIGMA (OECD/EU) peer assessments describe the institutional reality of Kosovo's procurement and audit system — data quality, publication compliance, OSHP independence — which calibrates how much to trust the primary sources and where systematic gaps in the record exist.

source_name: EUR-Lex — Participation of Kosovo in EU programmes (legal basis summaries)
why_relevant: Establishes which EU programmes Kosovo may participate in and under what agreements — determines whether a given EU call is even open to Kosovo entities, which is the eligibility filter for the whole cell.

source_name: Horizon Plus — case study: modernizing the Central Bank of Kosovo's digital platform
why_relevant: Concrete example of the cell's core hypothesis: a supplier publishes a named Kosovo financial-sector engagement (BQK digital platform) as a case study. The site's case-studies index is worth monitoring as a standing source, and the item itself points at a BQK contract to hunt in procurement records.

source_name: MCC / Federal Register — Kosovo Compact notices
why_relevant: Authoritative legal record of the MCC–Kosovo Compact (signed 15 July 2022, USD 202m MCC + USD 34.67m government contribution) that frames all MFK procurement. Federal Register is a stable, structured, API-accessible archive for compact amendments and closure notices.

source_name: OneFor (OneFor Holding GmbH, Düsseldorf) — Kosovo-licensed non-bank financial institution / digital payments app
why_relevant: Diaspora-focused wallet licensed by BQK as an IFJB — a new-generation buyer of card issuing, wallet, KYC and remittance-rail technology. Launch coverage in Albanian media is the practical way to date its licence and partner stack, since it publishes no tenders.

source_name: Open-Procurements.com — Kosovo country study on open procurement data and competition
why_relevant: A 2024 country study titled around utilising open data as a tool for greater competition, focused on Kosovo. Studies like this are pointer-rich secondary literature for the archival layer: they typically enumerate exactly which datasets exist, which fields are missing, which years are incomplete, and where the official publication practice changed — the metadata about the archive that no portal documents itself.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine - Procurement principles page (group procurement doctrine, readable)
why_relevant: The most fully public statement of Raiffeisen-group procurement principles, categories and vendor-qualification steps found in this cell. Useful as a proxy for how Raiffeisen Kosovo structures categories and evaluates bids, which helps interpret the sparse Kosovo notices.

source_name: Syri.net — investigative economy desk on Telekomi i Kosovës procurement
why_relevant: Kosovo media routinely surface negotiated-without-publication contracts that never appear as open tenders — exactly the procurement mode used for payment/billing platform extensions. Concrete example: an OCS billing-platform contract to Intracom (Skopje) worth ~EUR 146,900.

source_name: Transparent Public Procurement Rating — Kosovo country page
why_relevant: Independent methodological assessment of how complete and accessible Kosovo's procurement publication actually is. Directly informs how much we should trust the notice feed as a complete census of banking/payments lots.

source_name: US ITA Country Commercial Guide – Kosovo: Selling to the Public Sector
why_relevant: Concise English-language orientation to Kosovo's procurement institutions, thresholds and appeal route (KRPP, AQP, OSHP), useful for validating the actor map and for onboarding non-Albanian-speaking analysts. Not a data source.
